figures.caption: Figure 1: Overview of the LongSpike architecture. Compared with the baseline SpikingSSM [19], LongSpike incorporates fractional-order state-space dynamics into spiking neurons via an f -SSM module, enabling enhanced temporal modeling with efficient parallel computation.

Table 1: Performance comparison of LongSpike with other works on LRA benchmark. We take the 50% accuracy for the absence of Path-X accuracy as did in the work of S4D, then compute the overall average metrics across all tasks as AVG.

Table 4: The hyperparameters used in the experiments for various benchmark tasks. H denotes the model dimension, N denotes the state dimension, LR denotes learning rate, WD denotes weight decay, and BS denotes the batch size. BN and LN refer to Batch Normalization and Layer Normalization.

Figure 4: Layer-wise spiking rates on the TEXT task of the LRA benchmark. LongSpike maintains a comparable or lower average spiking rate (6.46%) than SpikingSSM (6.75%), indicating that performance improvements do not rely on increased neural activity.
